Key.English:
Class names of the headgear a braid
fits under, separated by commas.

Everything that inherits from one of
them counts as well. With any other
headgear the character wears her bun.

Default: the baseball caps, where the
braid comes out through the opening
at the back.

A character with a braid switches to
her bun while she wears a helmet and
gets the braid back when it comes off.

Off: a braid always stays a braid and
goes through the helmet.
